metadata.author: Benjiman Jennings
metadata.title: Dental Remediation Decision Memo
metadata.stakeholders: Benjiman Jennings; Jaden Cole; Lowry Beckett
metadata.demo_effect: Explains the recovery path and why the product is improving but not fully healthy yet.

payload.summary: Leadership approves a staged mitigation path for Dental, involving partial sandbox access, mock services for remaining gaps, and caution until full environment validation.

decisions.label: use partial sandbox access
decisions.anchorText: The team will use partial sandbox access beginning April 18

decisions.label: pair remaining gaps with mock services
decisions.anchorText: pair remaining gaps with mock services

decisions.label: treat the product as caution
decisions.anchorText: continue to treat the product as caution until full environment validation is available

decisions.label: update weekly narrative and report pack
decisions.anchorText: Jaden Cole updates the weekly narrative and report pack

decisions.label: circulate written milestone confirmation
decisions.anchorText: Lowry Beckett circulates written milestone confirmation

decisions.label: align the ADO board to the staged-access plan
decisions.anchorText: Delivery teams align the ADO board to the staged-access plan

warnings: Full vendor readiness is still targeted for April 25.
Integration test harness work remains necessary.
The stakeholder demo still depends on disciplined scoping.
